verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents a cash-basis income statement (P&L), a real-time business analysis report (BWA), and a trial balance, so the P&L part of the story is covered. The pack shows no balance sheet and no cash-flow statement; the petty-cash 'cash report' is a different feature and is not credited. Missing for 10: balance sheet generation, cash-flow statement generation, documented arbitrary-period selection, accrual-basis P&L, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: sevdesk prepares a cash-basis income statement from your income and expenses.
Create a real-time business analysis report (BWA) based on current data from your digital bookkeeping in sevdesk.
The trial balance gives you a detailed view of your accounts and journal entries.
